in_sanskrit.name: शोवकत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Showkat in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shov' meaning 'shining' and 'kat' meaning 'radiant' or 'beautiful'. It signifies a person who is full of radiance and beauty, and shines brightly in all aspects of life.

in_hindi.name: शोवकत
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Showkat in Hindi is derived from the Hindi words 'shov' meaning 'shining' and 'kat' meaning 'radiant' or 'beautiful'. It represents a person who is full of life and shines brightly, radiating a beautiful aura around them.

in_tamil.name: சோவகத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Showkat in Tamil is derived from the Tamil words 'so' meaning 'moon' and 'vakath' meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'. It symbolizes a person who is as radiant and beautiful as the moon, illuminating the world around them with their presence.

in_telugu.name: శోవకట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Showkat in Telugu is derived from the Telugu words 'shov' meaning 'shining' and 'kat' meaning 'radiant'. It represents a person who is full of life and shines brightly, illuminating the world around them with their beauty and charm.

in_marathi.name: Showkat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Showkat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Showkat is a combination of two words: 'Shauka' which means 'lion' and 'Tu' which means 'little'. So, Showkat means 'Little Lion'.
